# socialus-ops

The operating manual for building SocialUs: who does what, what triggers it, what it produces, and where it is broken. No product code here. `CLAUDE.md` holds the rules; this file is the map.

**Snapshot, 2026-10-11, regenerated by `regen-readme`.** A point-in-time picture rebuilt from the live repos, never hand-maintained (section 6). Every claim carries **[V]** verified (read or run on the snapshot date, source named) or **[A]** assumed. **[P]** marks a proposal that does not exist yet.

## 1. The chain

```
request / story
  -> plan-feature (council: design + plan)        stops at a brief the PM approves
  -> run-feature-pipeline (any feature, new or built): assess, do the first phase not done, reassess
       phases: filed, planned, ticketed, built, reviewed, shipped, smoked, reported, PM looked
  -> the CRITERION ROLL-UP (section 4): every acceptance criterion scored, rolled up to the dashboard
  -> the PM looks (phone checklist #519, ticks) -> "PM looked" -> launch report (Fridays)
```

Three layers: build (1), observe (2a: dashboard, criterion roll-up, STATUS, launch report), improve the pipeline (2b: the trial in section 7).

## 3. Roles

| Role | Owns | Never |
|---|---|---|
| PM | Rulings, whether a thing is *right*, the look | Reads code |
| Cowork | Planning repo: scenarios, decisions, roadmap | Commits code |
| Code | Web repo: Issues, TDD, PRs, merge on green | Writes scenarios or rulings |
| Dispatch | The PM's phone-side intake, shift handoffs, the 5am/5pm dashboard | Acts on an ask directly |

Shifts 5am-5pm and 5pm-5am, at most 3 area lanes, 2 build slots (`process/DISPATCH.md`) [V].

## 4. Criterion roll-up

**One name for the whole thing.** The *criterion roll-up* is the chain that scores every acceptance criterion, rolls the scores up (criterion, feature, area, milestone), and puts them on the dashboard. Its per-feature artifact is the *criterion report*. The same words are used in the dashboard header and section titles, the audit, the skills and this file [V].

```
 scenario criteria (plan) --+                      +-- phone checklist #519 (ticks) --+
 guards markers / evals ----+--> criterion report -+-- uat Issues -------------------+--> PM looked
 PR review, smoke ----------+    (regen-criterion-report)                              |
                                     |                                                |
                          socialus-plan/scripts/criteria.py   <------------------------+
                          (parses the reports; Checked from markers.py; Smoked, PM looked from runs and labels)
                                     |-> handoff/capabilities.md
                                     v
                          rollup(): criterion -> feature -> area -> milestone  (plain sums)
                                     v
                          dashboard.py (workflow: every push to main, and every 6 h) -> DASHBOARD.md + status-dashboard.html
```

**Where each step lives**

| Step | What does it | Trigger | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| Criteria | Cowork writes the scenario `Acceptance` list, the PM approves | a scenario is approved | 47 scenario files; 26 approved or building [V] |
| Criterion report | `regen-criterion-report` writes `socialus-web/build-log/reports/<area>/F###-<slug>.md`; every gap becomes an Issue | the all-feature run on 2026-10-10; the Friday refresh | 29 of 29 reportable features have one [V] |
| Parse and score | `socialus-plan/scripts/criteria.py` | each dashboard run | 235 criteria [V] |
| Phone checklist | `regen-uat-checklist` keeps issue #519 (label `uat`): 99 boxes, 9 sittings, launch-gated features first; a ticked box is "PM looked" for that criterion | the Friday task | 0 of 99 ticked [V] |
| Capabilities | `criteria.py --capabilities` -> `handoff/capabilities.md` | Friday task | generated 2026-10-10 [V] |
| Dashboard | `dashboard.py`, run by `.github/workflows/dashboard.yml` | push to main, every 6 h, dispatch | last scheduled run did not fire (section 8) [V] |
| Audit | `regen-criterion-audit` -> `audits/criterion-rollup.md` | on request, Friday | regenerated this snapshot [V] |

**Formulas** (all plain sums, none an average of features or a count of Issues):
- A criterion is **built** only when its report row says `yes`; `unknown` counts as unmet.
- **Checked** = a guards marker covers the whole criterion (`markers.py coverage`, the same count as STATUS). **Reviewed** = the row says yes. **Smoked** = a green smoke-live run came after the feature's last merge (pages load; not behaviour). **PM looked** = a ticked box in a `uat` Issue, or `pm-reviewed` on a linked Issue.
- Feature = criteria met / total. Area and milestone = the sum of their criteria. The beta % is **criteria met / total**; Issues closed is shown beside it, not as the headline.
- A feature or area is **red** when an unmet criterion links an open `launch-blocking` Issue. A report older than its last merged PR is flagged **stale**.

**Today** [V, dashboard regenerated 2026-10-11]: 141 of 235 criteria met (60%) across 29 features; checked 40, reviewed 16, smoked 114, PM looked 1; 9 features red (F058, F076, F078, F081, F082, F093, F100, F101, F102); Issues closed 69 of 124.

**The PM's part.** Open https://github.com/donlafranchi/socialus-web/issues/519 on a phone and tick what you looked at; closing a `uat` Issue with every box ticked labels what it names `pm-reviewed` (`uat-close.yml`). Reporting, removing, hiding or publishing steps say to use a test Page. `record-pm-review` takes "<thing> ok" or "<thing> broken: why".

**Second track, not reconciled [V].** `scripts/criteria.py` in this repo (merged, #94) treats a JSON sidecar next to each report as the truth and renders the tables from it. The dashboard does not use it. Its companions, `socialus-web` #659 and `skills` #17, are open. The live roll-up parses the markdown reports. Until one is chosen, edits to a report's format belong in neither track alone.

## 5. Other systems

**Decision rule.** Look first (2-3 precedents), choose the simplest, label the work `Path: well-worn` (build it) or `Path: new territory` (A/B/C to the PM). [V] `CLAUDE.md`.

**Feature intake council, run by `plan-feature`.** One sentence in, a Feature Brief out (nine roles, a chair, three sizes); it stops until the PM sets `status: approved`. The council prompt is V0 (`planning/council/feature-intake.md`). The beta-scope council decided what ships, once. [V]

**Skills** (28, in `skills/`; `skills/README.md` is the index) [V]:
- Plan: `scope-scenario`, `review-draft-scenario`, `plan-feature`, `sync-roadmap`, `trim-product-docs`, `write-launch-report`.
- Build: `write-tickets` (one Issue per criterion), `build-ticket`, `diagnose-bug`, `respond-to-review`, `run-feature-pipeline`, `review-pr-bundle`, `review-live-design`, `record-pm-review`.
- Generate (`regen-<doc>`): `regen-status`, `regen-dashboard`, `regen-decisions`, `regen-readme`, `regen-capabilities`, `regen-criterion-report`, `regen-criterion-audit`, `regen-uat-checklist`, `regen-safety-runbook`.
- Meta (trial): `score-ci-health`, `score-doc-drift`, `score-gap-leakage`.
- Cross-cutting: `verify-before-done`, `author-skill`.

**CI** (`socialus-web`, 23 workflows) [V `gh workflow list`]: merge gates (`ci`, `ci-docs-only`, `boundaries`, `issue-lint`, `review`, `migrations (check)`); deploy and health (`deploy-health`, `apply`, `signup hook readiness`); `smoke-live` (errors and leaks on the changed screens, nightly) and `tap-speed` (its own workflow since #664); `uat-close`; scheduled content and ops jobs. `socialus-plan` has `lint`, `status` and `dashboard`; this repo has `lint` and `pm-approved-guard`.

**Scheduled work.** The desktop scheduler holds one recurring task, `friday-meta-trial-and-launch-report` (Fridays 9:10): scores, tuning notes, criterion-report refresh, checklist upkeep, capabilities, dashboard, runbook check, launch report [V `list_scheduled_tasks`]. The 5am/5pm handoff and a weekly disk cleanup are Dispatch's [A: not inspected].

**Safety runbook.** `runbooks/staff-safety.md`, generated by `scripts/regen_safety_runbook.py` from the F078, F100, F101 and F102 rulings and stamped with a hash (`--check` fails when a ruling changes). One section per severity tier; the apparent-CSAM tier says to preserve, view no more than needed, never copy or forward, and file through NCMEC's public CyberTipline form during beta. No personal names, no entity detail, not legal advice. A link from the admin reports page is `socialus-web` #667. [V]

**Launch checklist.** `socialus-plan/planning/launch-checklist.json` holds dated reminders; the dashboard and the Friday report show them. First item: register SocialUs with the NCMEC CyberTipline, switch off the manual form, enable Cloudflare CSAM scanning. It fires at entity setup (expected early 2027) or production launch (April-May 2027), whichever is first. [V]

**Exploration notes** (directions, not rulings): `socialus-plan/product/exploration/search-direction.md` (Google-style words, no hashtags, natural language later) and `ai-moderation-scoring.md` (four scoring models, sources, an A/B/C awaiting the PM). The Charter recommendation (`socialus-plan` #64: one page replaces `goals.md`) is open for the PM's A/B/C. [V]

**Lint and living-doc tooling** (`scripts/`): `lint.sh` (CI; proves each checker on bad fixtures), `markers.py`, `never.py`, `risks-due.sh`, the vendored `status.sh`, `state.sh`, `view.sh`. [V]

## 6. Docs are generated

A doc that describes state is regenerated from live sources, never edited. Authored rules (`CLAUDE.md`, `process/*`) stay by hand.

| Doc | Generator | Trigger |
|---|---|---|
| `STATUS.md`, plan `README.md` | `status.sh`, `view.sh` via `status.yml` | push to main, daily 13:05 UTC |
| `DASHBOARD.md`, `dashboard/status-dashboard.html` | `dashboard.py` via `dashboard.yml` | push to main, every 6 h |
| `build-log/reports/**` (criterion reports) | `regen-criterion-report` | all-feature run; Friday refresh |
| `handoff/capabilities.md` | `criteria.py --capabilities` | Friday |
| `audits/criterion-rollup.md` | `regen-criterion-audit` | on request, Friday |
| `runbooks/staff-safety.md` | `regen_safety_runbook.py` | when a ruling changes |
| `README.md` (this file) | `regen-readme` | after process changes |
| `DECISIONS.md` | `regen-decisions` (prune only) | weekly |
| `handoff/latest.md` | Dispatch `dispatch-handoff` (not in the skills library) | 5am/5pm |

## 7. Meta layer (**TRIAL**, started 2026-10-10)

The PM's instruction: *stick with this and keep improving it.* The trial is **tuning, not a go/no-go**; dropping it is not an option. Tuning review 2026-10-24: is each score measuring what it should (false reds and misses, with examples), what to adjust, which score is next. Tracker: [#89](https://github.com/donlafranchi/socialus-ops/issues/89), pinned.

**Built:** the `pm-approved` guard (`scripts/pm-approved-guard.cjs`, now also protecting `scripts/score_*.py` and `scripts/trial_health.py`), `score-ci-health`, `score-doc-drift`, `score-gap-leakage`, `scripts/trial_health.py`. **Not built:** `score-review-coverage`, `score-rework`, `score-pm-overrule`, and the reviewer `review-pipeline`.

| Score | Signal | Reading (2026-10-11) |
|---|---|---|
| `score-ci-health` | CI fail %, red scheduled workflows, smoke red %, repos whose Actions cannot start | CI fail 26.3% (red); smoke red 100% of 2 scheduled runs (red); Actions blocked in `skills` (red) [V] |
| `score-doc-drift` | generated-doc age, skill list vs `link.sh` vs table, README claims, approved scenarios with every Issue closed | last reading 2026-10-10: 11 items (red) [V `scores/`] |
| `score-gap-leakage` | closed Issues hiding unmet criteria; unmet criteria with no open Issue; built criteria with no marked check | 16 features, 21 criteria, 74.5% (all red; first reading, with tuning notes on what is likely a false red) [V `scores/`] |

**Governance.** PM approval is the only merge path for `meta-change` PRs; a score skill, formula, `trial_health.py` or the guard is never edited by an agent on its own. The guard is a tripwire, not a lock: agents act with the owner's token, and in `skills` (private, Actions blocked) it runs by hand (`scripts/pm-approved-check.cjs`). [V]

**Reminder.** Every Friday the launch report and the dashboard carry a "Meta-layer trial" block (`trial_health.py --block`) and the run writes `scores/tuning/YYYY-MM-DD.md`.

## 8. Gaps

- **Smoke:** `smoke-live` is green after the tap-speed split (run 38111222357 on main, 25 passed), but its scheduled runs are late or missing: the 10:30 UTC run on 2026-10-11 started at 16:23. Tap speed is red (#555): the Explore card and post card opening a Page take about 2 s against a 1 s budget, and the 20% regression rule flips on small taps. [V `gh run list`]
- **GitHub's `schedule` trigger is unreliable here.** On 2026-10-11 no scheduled run of the dashboard workflow fired at 06:20 or 12:20 UTC, and `tap-speed` at 11:00 UTC did not fire. The dashboard now also runs on every push to main; smoke-live and tap-speed have no such backstop. [V]
- **PM looked is 1 of 235.** None of the 99 phone-checklist boxes is ticked and no real `uat` Issue has been closed. [V]
- **94 of 124 milestone items have no acceptance criteria** (changes, bugs, chores), so they have no criterion-level result. [V `audits/criterion-rollup.md`]
- **Checked is 17%** (40 of 235 criteria have a marked test). [V]
- **Two criterion-report tracks** (section 4): the markdown parser the dashboard reads, and the JSON-sidecar tool in this repo with `socialus-web` #659 and `skills` #17 open. #17 also edits `regen-feature-report`, which is now `regen-criterion-report`, so it will conflict. [V]
- **The guard cannot run in `skills`** (private; Actions blocked on billing). Merges there rely on the by-hand check. [V]
- **Open meta-change items waiting on the PM:** `scripts/trial_health.py` still counts two built scores and lists `score-gap-leakage` as next; `score-doc-drift/SKILL.md` still names `regen-feature-report`. Both are guard-protected, so each is a `meta-change` PR for the PM's `pm-approved`. [V]
- **Process contradiction:** `PIPELINE.md` says "Cowork merges" method PRs; `CLAUDE.md` says self-merge on green lint. Practice has been self-merge. [V]
- **Stale names:** `~/Projects/ops-pattern` duplicate checkout; `ops-pattern` in `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `DISPATCH.md` and `PIPELINE.md` paths; `dashboard/index.html` in `DISPATCH.md` vs the real `status-dashboard.html`. [V]
- **`dispatch-handoff`** is not in the skills library. **`socialus-design`** has no remote. [V]
- **Pending the PM:** the disk cleanup's 22 stale worktrees (11.5 GiB) wait for a yes; the Charter A/B/C; the F092 wording (#619, #621); the moderation scoring A/B/C. [V]

## 9. What the PM needs to do

1. Tick boxes on the phone checklist (#519), launch-gated sittings first.
2. Approve or answer: the moderation scoring A/B/C, the Charter A/B/C, the F092 wording, the worktree cleanup.
3. Apply `pm-approved` to the two open `meta-change` PRs if they look right, so the trial's health numbers stay true.
4. Choose one criterion-report format (markdown parser or JSON sidecar).

## 10. Commands

```
scripts/lint.sh                              # all checkers and fixtures
python3 scripts/score_ci_health.py           # trial scores (also score_doc_drift, score_gap_leakage)
python3 scripts/audit_criterion_rollup.py    # the criterion roll-up audit
python3 scripts/regen_safety_runbook.py --check
./link.sh                                    # in the skills repo, after any skill change
```

## 11. Changing the method

Branch `process-YYYY-MM-DD-slug`, commit `docs: what`, add a `LESSONS.md` line naming the dated failure, open a PR, merge when `lint` is green. This repo is public: nothing secret, legal or personal goes in it.
